verdict.rationale: Rippling documents workflow automation (e.g. triggering reminders, Slack alerts from Zendesk tickets) and recurring payroll runs, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose scheduler or cron-like recurring job/workflow engine aimed at AI-native automation; the CLI (rippling-cli) is for deploying integrations, not scheduling jobs. missing for 10: explicit recurring/cron scheduling API or UI, AI-native trigger configuration, evidence of arbitrary job scheduling beyond payroll cadence.
